name: @mainspring/desktop
description: Experimental Electron shell for the local Mainspring console.
author: Mainspring contributors

scripts.clean: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('node:fs').rmSync('release', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter @mainspring/console build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.pack: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter @mainspring/console build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron-builder
